review_type: single AI curator; complete final answer personally read; identity visible; original scientific-quality rubric

errors.issue: The packet predicts attenuation of responses to fully predicted reward; an absent phasic SURE response can be the correct learned result. Automatically invalidating waiting data for this pattern rejects a scientifically valid preparation.

errors.quote: Rewarded and certain-omission controls are indistinguishable
errors.issue: Certain reward and certain no-reward can both lack an outcome prediction error. This is not by itself assay failure; validate unexpected reward/omission and independent neural identity without this contradictory gate.

errors.quote: Actual outcome probabilities diverge materially from programmed probabilities
errors.issue: Independent Bernoulli schedules can fluctuate legitimately. Repeating sessions until realized rates fit a tolerance selects histories; distinguish software/delivery failure from valid stochastic variation and model the retained realized sequence.

errors.quote: If one blinded interim analysis is planned
errors.issue: An interval on the uncertainty treatment coefficient requires decoded condition information; call it an independent monitoring analysis and calibrate the stopping rule rather than describe it as a blinded nuisance check.

errors.quote: the same physical cue does not consistently produce the same neural pattern
errors.issue: This prediction is reversed for a cue-identity artifact: a sensory artifact should tend to follow physical identity across remappings. The subsequent old-cue/new-probability prediction is more appropriate.

errors.quote: Use prespecified waveform stability and neuron-identification criteria.
errors.issue: No concrete independently validated dopamine identity method, region/platform or sensor/recording preparation is selected. Calibration of sensor impulse response and transient contamination is also missing for the optional photometry route.

The interval is specified but no independent cue-transient/sensor-kinetic validation establishes clean separation. Actual reward amounts, neural sampling, preparation and welfare implementation remain incomplete.

rationale: Strong full-grid and matched-distribution conceptual design, animal-level inference and measured-behavior caveats. However the explicit SURE-no-response invalidation and certain-control gate contradict the supplied learned-reward evidence and can reject valid recordings. Core question/mechanism/intervention present; readout/prediction do not qualify under these gates.
reference_guardrails: All three complete final answers personally read against full question/reference/target; truncated Grok tail and Qwen middle sections separately read. Original rubric only; strict round inactive.

Historical qualification follows explicit reference core: uncertainty versus value, probability manipulation, separated phasic/delay readouts, intermediate-versus-endpoint prediction. Matched-value/magnitude challenges improve scientific identification; their incomplete implementation limits quality without silently becoming an extra binary gate.

Ramping or late pre-outcome activity can be an uncertainty correlate. Its timing alone cannot select hazard. Assess joint probability-by-time models and timing controls; never reject the historical direction solely because its signal grows near outcome.

Physiological dopamine identity is putative unless independently validated; selecting cells for event responses biases the sampled population. A preparation-level assay check is distinct from per-neuron response selection.

Fixed-magnitude inverted-U activity distinguishes certain prespecified linear/value models, not every nonlinear value, salience, temporal or movement model. Correlated covariate adjustment and held-out decoding do not alone identify cause.

Probability probes and run-limited schedules alter experienced contingencies. Preserve actual conditional probabilities, history and all valid anticipatory trials; future-outcome splits are diagnostics, not grounds for outcome-based neural selection.

The primary paper itself documents incomplete intermediate-probability coverage in a subset of cells. This is a limitation to disclose, not proof of fabrication or a reason to copy the sampling bias. Reference guardrails remain modern proposed controls, not claims that the historical study implemented them.

Source depth: primary PDF abstract, experiment description, Results and figure captions through Fig. 3 personally read. Supporting Methods not audited. Do not certify the paper or reconstruct missing procedures from those excerpts.
